home.step2Text: Each requirement is checked against your profile, with the reason shown.

static.draftNotice: This text is a draft pending legal review. It is not final.
static.aboutP1: Circular2Action helps people in Bangladesh find job, scholarship and internship circulars, understand whether they qualify, and keep track of every deadline.
static.aboutP2: Each opportunity links to its official circular. We do not apply on your behalf and we never ask for payments.
static.privacyP1: We collect only what we need to run your account and show you relevant opportunities: your email, name and the profile details you choose to add.
static.privacyP2: Your profile is used only to check eligibility for you. You can export or delete your data at any time from Settings.
static.termsP1: Circular2Action is a guide. Opportunity details come from official circulars and may change. Always confirm with the official circular before you apply.
static.termsP2: You must be 18 or older to create an account. Do not share your password.
static.helpQ1: How do I check if I qualify?
static.helpA1: Open an opportunity and choose “Check my eligibility”. Add your details in your profile for a personal result.
static.helpQ2: Why does a result say “needs verification”?
static.helpA2: Some requirements could not be confirmed against the official circular yet. Check the circular itself.
static.helpQ3: How do I stop tracking an application?
static.helpA3: Open it in the tracker and choose “Stop tracking”.
